server.name: io.github.Cloto-dev/cpersona
server.description: Persistent AI memory in one SQLite file: 3-layer hybrid search, confidence scoring, 29 tools.
server.title: CPersona

environmentVariables.description: SQLite database path. Defaults to ./cpersona.db, which follows the client's working directory — set it explicitly to keep one memory across sessions.
environmentVariables.name: CPERSONA_DB_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Embedding mode: 'http' to use an embedding server for vector search, 'none' for lexical layers only.
environmentVariables.name: CPERSONA_EMBEDDING_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Embedding server endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8401/embed. Required when CPERSONA_EMBEDDING_MODE=http.
environmentVariables.name: CPERSONA_EMBEDDING_URL

environmentVariables.description: Recall fusion strategy: 'rrf' (default), 'rsf', or 'cascade'.
environmentVariables.name: CPERSONA_RECALL_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Embedding server endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8401/embed. Required when CPERSONA_EMBEDDING_MODE=http.

environmentVariables.description: Recall fusion strategy: 'rrf' (default), 'rsf', or 'cascade'.
environmentVariables.name: CPERSONA_RECALL_MODE
